_about: Append-only.  For each split-filter prompt, every version and the SHA-256 of its text (the fenced block of its rubric file).  A version names one text.  Add a row with data_analysis/gap_generation/rubric_pins.py bump NAME --why TEXT; never edit a row.

sense.why: First pin: draft 6 (Roger edits of 2026-09-29 plus the where-someone-comes-from clause); matches probe_single/run.json draft6

Draft 7: a word said of what people do or make has a reading about the person who does it that way (educational, historical got only secondary readings in the full validation run); Roger 2026-10-01, readout decision 4
Draft 8: the draft-7 clause softened (may also have such a reading; primary only when most readers would take the instruction so). Draft 7 promoted one-time, organic, chemical, threadbare

established.why: First pin: draft 4 (the test of ordinary speech); matches probe_rerun_wording/run_established.json

Draft 5: the sentence test made explicit (wordy, porous), a clause for words for how someone speaks or works, trait-hood judged elsewhere; full validation run 2026-09-30 called killing/ritual/conclusive well known and approximate/metaphorical/futuristic stretched
Draft 6: the example word wordy (draft 5, never run) replaced by plainspoken, since wordy is on the reserved-words list of the hygiene test

Draft 7: draft 4's text plus one clause (a word for how someone speaks, writes, thinks or works counts as said of the person when people say it of her manner or work; trait-hood not this check's question). Drafts 5 and 6 withdrawn: 84 of 99 on the test words against 92

kind.why: First pin: draft 4 (a standing practice counts as a trait); matches probe_rerun_wording/run.json

Draft 5: what others do to or think of the person is not a trait, not_a_persona (idolized, unfavorable, unheeded, sought passed as traits in the full validation run); Roger 2026-10-01, readout decision 2

Draft 6: draft 5's sentence replaced; others' regard (liked, admired) is a trait like the effect the person has on others, what others happen to be doing about the person just now (ignoring, pursuing) is a state. Draft 5 turned away popular, unpopular and bothersome (r7_effect_probe)

same_sense.why: Draft 2 (Roger, 2026-09-30, QUESTIONS.md 22): example readings use near-duplicates of corpus terms: casual conversation -> idle conversation, cheerful -> chipper, casual -> informal, resentful -> embittered. Matches probe_rubric_edits/same_sense/run.json

gloss.why: First pin: draft 2 (This means plus an -ing verb, no subject); matches probe_gloss_v2/run.json

Draft 3 (Roger, 2026-09-30: 'The fact wins'): for a plain fact the length gives way ('however short that leaves the sentence'), and no details the reading does not give; Sonnet 5.5 had padded 8 of 13 membership glosses. Matches probe_rubric_edits/gloss/run.json

alignment.why: First pin: first draft; matches probe_last_step/run.json
Draft 2 (Roger, 2026-09-30, QUESTIONS.md 22): example word cheerful -> chipper. Matches probe_rubric_edits/alignment/run.json

Draft 3 (Roger, 2026-09-30): a score of 0 to 3 in place of yes or no, a seventh heading on harm; answer key alignment (0-3) replaces alignment_relevant. Text of alignment_graded_draft.md draft 4; matches probe_alignment_graded/draft4_corpus/run.json
